exposure: umbilical cord blood gas analysis (BGA) results
delivery characteristics (cesarean section history, preterm delivery)
cohort: The study included 593 consecutive-term newborns delivered in a tertiary referral center in Turkey between January 2020 and December 2022.
finding: The study found significant correlations between composite adverse neonatal outcomes and advanced maternal age, cesarean section history, preterm delivery, lower one- and five-minute APGAR scores, and acidemia severity, but weak correlations between BGA parameters and APGAR scores.
mod_finding: Cesarean section history was significantly correlated with composite adverse neonatal outcomes.
